protocol.name: dsk_surface_v1
protocol.copyright: Copyright © 2026 the desktop project authors SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

description.summary: compositor-drawn shape, elevation, motion and gestures

protocol.description:
The client commits pixels once; the compositor draws corners and shadow from design tokens, runs animations, and runs finger-driven gestures with their inertia. Curves are the shared libdesk-motion curves, so a client can compute any in-between value itself from a started event.
Pointer and touch input follow the current animated transform and are clipped to the current clip rect.
Only unsandboxed clients see this global.

request.name: get_surface

description.summary: extend a wl_surface

request.description: One dsk_surface_v1 per wl_surface; a second one is a protocol error.

request.name: get_tracker

description.summary: a compositor-owned gesture on a surface

request.description: The compositor receives the gesture input inside the tracker's region, moves the tracker position, and on release runs inertia and a spring to a snap point. Bindings map the position to properties of any dsk_surface_v1 of this client.

interface.name: dsk_surface_v1

description.summary: shape, elevation and animations of one surface

interface.description: All requests are double-buffered and apply on the next wl_surface.commit, so new pixels and the motion that shows them start in the same frame.

request.name: destroy

description.summary: drop the extension

request.description: Running animations stop at their current value.

entry.name: invalid_value
entry.summary: an enum argument is out of range

entry.name: translate
entry.summary: a = x, b = y, logical px

entry.name: scale
entry.summary: a = uniform scale about the surface center

entry.name: clip
entry.summary: a, b, c, d = x, y, width, height, surface-local px

entry.name: liquid
entry.summary: a = refraction 0..1 at the rim (before 15 the blur also gets lighter with it); b = specular rim 0..1; c (since 9) = lens 0..1: the sharp backdrop through the rim band; before 9 the lens follows a; d = 0..1 how far a full glass density lifts the tint alpha (glass::denser): 0 half the lift, 1 all of it

entry.name: stroke
entry.summary: a, b, c, d = r, g, b, alpha 0..1 of a 1 px hairline inside the clip shape; drawn only while a clip is set

entry.name: tint
entry.summary: a, b, c, d = r, g, b, alpha 0..1 of the material tint the compositor draws over the blur, under the surface; it raises alpha over a same-tone backdrop; a client that sends alpha > 0 paints no tint of its own

entry.name: join
entry.summary: a = the clip edge that joins another shape: 0 none, 1 top, 2 right, 3 bottom, 4 left; b = flare radius, px: the two corners on that edge curve outward (concave) along the edge, outside the clip; c (since 23) = 1: the flares of corners run across their edge, outward along the two sides

entry.name: fill
entry.summary: a, b, c, d = r, g, b, alpha 0..1 of a flat fill the compositor draws in the clip shape, over the surface glass and under its content, with no blur; on a dsk_shape_v1 a fill makes a flat shape: it draws no glass and does not replace the surface glass

entry.name: fill_dense
entry.summary: a = fill alpha at full glass density; the fill alpha follows the density of the glass under it from the fill alpha to this one

entry.name: blur
entry.summary: a = blur size 0..1 of the surface glass; without it the blur follows liquid a

entry.name: solo
entry.summary: a = 1: this dsk_shape_v1 never joins a neighbour shape into one liquid outline; 0 (default) it joins within merge reach

entry.name: rotation
entry.summary: a = rotation, radians clockwise about the clip center, of a dsk_shape_v1 glass shape (blur, rim, tint); a rotated shape draws no elevation shadow and no fill, never joins a neighbour and takes no join flares; the surface itself ignores it

entry.name: corners
entry.summary: a, b, c, d = top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left radius, px, of the glass (blur, rim, tint) of a dsk_shape_v1; when any is not 0 it replaces radius and join a, b there (elevation, fill and stroke keep radius). A negative radius is a concave flare of that size outside the clip: the two of a left or right side flare along that side, any other along its top or bottom edge (join c turns them across). Ignored on a rotated shape

entry.name: glass
entry.summary: a = 1: the surface glass (blur, rim, tint) fills the clip shape, clip and radius, with no blur region; 0 (default): only a blur region turns the surface glass on. The surface draws no glass while no clip is set. Ignored on a dsk_shape_v1

enum.name: curve

description.summary: motion tokens

enum.description: Springs use the tokens spring.* (damping is the ratio to critical). There are no duration animations: ease_* are deprecated and map to a critically damped fade spring (they never overshot).

entry.name: cancelled
entry.summary: set, unmap, or a tracker took over

request.name: set_elevation

description.summary: set the shadow level at once

request.description: Same as set of the elevation property with a whole level. From version 4 the level is a property: animate it with the clip so the shadow grows with the shape. Each level draws a key and a contact shadow. Between none and e1 the blur stays that of the float level while offset and opacity scale with the level; between e1 and e2 all values interpolate.

request.name: set

description.summary: set a property at once

request.description: Stops a running animation on it (done, reason cancelled). Unused components are ignored.

request.name: animate

description.summary: animate a property from its current value

request.description: Starts from the current presented value. On a running animation it retargets and keeps the velocity (spring curves). The serial comes back in started and done. With the reduce_motion appearance setting, every property but opacity moves at once.

event.name: started

description.summary: the animation's first presented frame

event.description: time is CLOCK_MONOTONIC ms of that frame; with the curve and the start value the client can compute every later value itself.

request.name: set_clip_from

description.summary: clip to a rect of another surface

request.description: Sets clip, as a set of clip would, to a rect given in the source surface's local coordinates. The source position is read now, this surface's position at the commit that applies the request, so it works on the commit that maps this surface. Neither surface's own translate or scale counts. An island grows into its sheet by this request followed by an animate of clip. The source must be a mapped layer surface and this surface a layer surface; otherwise the request does nothing and clip_mapped is not sent.

event.name: clip_mapped

description.summary: the clip set_clip_from computed

event.description: Sent at once for each set_clip_from that took effect, with the rect in this surface's coordinates, so the client can animate back to it.

event.name: backdrop

description.summary: the backdrop under the liquid glass changed tone

event.description: Deprecated: the compositor no longer sends it. Glass keeps the tone of the colour scheme and adapts only its density (the density event).

event.name: density

description.summary: how much the compositor thickens the glass tint

event.description: The density the compositor gives this surface's tint, 0 to 1: it rises over a backdrop of the tint's own tone (dark glass over a bright backdrop, light glass over a dark one) so text stays legible. Sent with the first backdrop measurement, then each time the target changes; the compositor fades the drawn tint to it. Content that must follow the tint (card fills) uses this value.

request.name: set_visible_region

description.summary: the part of the surface that can show pixels

request.description: Surface-local area outside of which every pixel of this surface is fully transparent, shadows included. The compositor may skip drawing anything of the surface outside it, in every path (composition and planes). A null region means the whole surface (the default). Double-buffered: it applies on the next wl_surface.commit, so a client that grows its content sends the new region with the same commit.

request.name: get_shape

description.summary: add a glass shape to the surface

request.description: A surface can hold several glass shapes (islands of a bar, cards of a sheet), each with its own clip, corners, tint, liquid, elevation, stroke and fill. Shapes draw in creation order, under the surface content. While a surface has a glass shape (a shape with a clip and no fill), its own clip, radius, tint, liquid, elevation and stroke draw no glass, and the compositor ignores its blur region for glass. The surface translate, scale and opacity move and fade every shape with it.

request.name: launch_from

description.summary: the icon an app launch starts from

request.description: The client starts an app from the icon at this surface-local rectangle (a dock item, a launcher row). The next xdg_activation_v1 token with an app id that the same client commits within 1 second takes it: the compositor shows the icon's pixels, as committed when this request arrives, moving away from the icon until the app's first window maps or the launch expires. Takes effect at once, not on commit.

request.name: set_glass_mask

description.summary: glass in the shape of a mask, over the surface

request.description: The compositor draws glass (the blurred scene under it, with the glass tint) over this surface where the buffer's alpha is at least 0.5: for example the digits of a clock. The buffer is a wl_shm ARGB8888 buffer of any size, stretched over the surface-local rectangle (x, y, width, height); a client renders it at its output scale. The compositor keeps the buffer until a new mask replaces it, then releases it. A null buffer removes the mask. Double-buffered: it applies on the next wl_surface.commit.

request.name: set_secure

description.summary: keep the surface out of captures

request.description: While secure is 1, screenshots, screen casts and recordings of an output show this surface and its subsurfaces as an opaque black rectangle, and a capture of a window whose main surface is secure shows nothing. The screen itself shows the surface as usual. A surface with the wl_pointer cursor role is not covered: captures show the cursor the client sets. Double-buffered: setting 1 applies on the next wl_surface.commit; setting 0 applies when the state of that commit applies, so a buffer held back by a synchronized subsurface or a fence stays covered until it replaces the old one.

request.name: set_content_region

description.summary: the part of the surface that draws pixels

request.description: Surface-local area outside of which every pixel of this surface is fully transparent, shadows included. Unlike set_visible_region it clips neither drawing nor input: the compositor only treats the surface as absent outside it when it decides what glass above the surface samples, so glass over the clear part may reuse a cached backdrop. A null region means the whole surface (the default). Double-buffered: it applies on the next wl_surface.commit.

request.name: window_icon

description.summary: where a window's icon sits on this surface

request.description: The window with this ext-foreign-toplevel identifier has its icon at this surface-local rectangle (a dock item). Minimizing the window shrinks it into the icon, and restoring grows it out of the icon. An empty rectangle forgets it. Takes effect at once, not on commit.

entry.name: shown
entry.summary: the user can see the window

entry.name: occluded
entry.summary: opaque windows cover all of it

entry.name: hidden
entry.summary: minimized, on another workspace or a background tab

entry.name: off
entry.summary: the session is locked or every output it is on is off

event.name: presence

description.summary: what the user can see of this toplevel

event.description: Sent for the root surface of a mapped toplevel: once when the toplevel maps or when this object is created for a mapped one, then each time the value changes. Content that only matters on screen (animations, polls, previews) pauses unless the value is shown. Frame callbacks follow their own rules: a captured window still gets them while hidden.

request.name: set_backdrop_probe

description.summary: measure the backdrop under a surface with no glass

request.description: While enabled is 1, the compositor measures the luminance of the backdrop under this surface's clip, even when the surface asks for no glass and no blur, and reports it with backdrop_luminance. It draws nothing for the probe. A measurement runs only when the backdrop under the surface changes. Double-buffered: applies on the next wl_surface.commit. Only a layer-shell surface measures: a commit that enables the probe on a surface of another role is an invalid_value error.

event.name: backdrop_luminance

description.summary: the mean luminance of the backdrop

event.description: The mean relative luminance, 0 (black) to 1 (white), of the backdrop under this surface. Sent with the first measurement after set_backdrop_probe enables the probe, then each time the value moves by a visible step. Content drawn with no surface (text on the wallpaper) picks its ink from it.

interface.name: dsk_shape_v1

description.summary: one glass shape of a dsk_surface_v1

interface.description: Uses the property, curve and reason enums of dsk_surface_v1. Requests are double-buffered on the parent wl_surface commit. translate and scale are surface properties: a shape ignores them. Since version 18 a shape's opacity multiplies its glass, fill and shadow (before 18 it was ignored); the surface opacity still applies on top. A shape with no clip draws nothing. A shape whose dsk_surface_v1 is gone is inert.

request.name: destroy

description.summary: remove the shape

request.description: The shape stops drawing at once.

request.name: set

description.summary: set a property at once

request.description: Stops a running animation on it (done, reason cancelled).

request.name: animate

description.summary: animate a property from its current value

request.description: As dsk_surface_v1.animate. Animations of shapes and of the surface sent before one commit start in the same frame.

entry.name: sine
entry.summary: 0.5 - 0.5 cos: low at the start, high at half the period

entry.name: noise
entry.summary: a smooth pseudo-random level from a sum of sines; the seed decorrelates shapes

request.name: loop

description.summary: repeat a motion until replaced

request.description: The property moves between its current value (low) and a, b, c, d (high) with t = wave(time / period) in 0..1, each component linear in t, from the frame the loop starts (started event) until a set, animate or loop on the property replaces it (done, reason cancelled or retargeted). The loop never finishes on its own. The compositor draws its frames only while the surface is mapped, on an enabled output and not fully transparent: a hidden loop costs no frames. Use it for decorative motion that would otherwise need a client frame per tick.

interface.name: dsk_tracker_v1

description.summary: a compositor-owned gesture

interface.description: A one-dimensional position the compositor drives from input, after the Windows InteractionTracker model: interacting, then inertia, then idle. Configuration is double-buffered on the tracker's wl_surface commit.

entry.name: invalid_value
entry.summary: an enum argument is out of range

request.name: set_source

description.summary: where and how the gesture starts

request.description: region is surface-local; null means the whole surface. fingers is the touchpad finger count of a swipe (vertical, horizontal) or a pinch. fingers 0 is a left-button pointer drag or a one-finger touch drag: the client gets the press, and once the drag moves 8 px along the axis the compositor claims it and the client gets a pointer leave or touch cancel. A pinch from scale 1 to 2 moves the whole range.

description.summary: position limits; past them the motion rubber-bands
a rest position; inertia ends on the snap the throw projects to

request.name: bind

description.summary: drive a property from the position

request.description: Maps position p0..p1 linearly to value v0..v1 on one component (0 = a .. 3 = d) of a property of target. Values clamp outside the range. The elevation property cannot be bound (invalid_value).

request.name: move_to

description.summary: drive the position without input, for example a click that opens

request.description: Springs from the current position and velocity. Curve none, or the reduce_motion appearance setting, moves at once and sends idle. A running gesture is not interrupted.

request.name: watch

description.summary: per-frame position (opt-in)

request.description: A position event follows every presented frame that moved it. Use it only for client pixels that must follow the finger, for example the bar's workspace indicator during a workspace swipe. Animations need no per-frame events: curves are deterministic from started.

description.summary: released; the position will rest at target
